title: The Blue Pearl | 4BR Rental on 30A | Royal Destinations
meta_description: The Blue Pearl is a luxury 4BR Blue Mountain Beach home with a private pool, spa, and golf cart. This 30A rental sleeps 14 by Royal Destinations. Reserve today!
description_expanded: Description: The Blue Pearl by Royal Destinations Location: Blue Mountain Beach Address: 2186 S Co Hwy 83, Santa Rosa Beach, FL 32459 Escape to The Blue Pearl, a stunning three-story retreat in Blue Mountain Beach just steps away from the sugar-white sands and crystal-clear waters of the Gulf. This luxurious home features four ensuite bedrooms and sleeps up to 14 guests, making it the perfect getaway for families. Inside, you’ll find an ideal floor plan with plenty of space for everyone. The home includes a bunk room that comfortably sleeps eight, along with two master suites featuring large second- and third-story porches where you can relax and take in the breeze. The gourmet kitchen is equipped with Wolf appliances and plenty of dining space, making it easy to enjoy meals together as a family. Step outside to the gorgeous private pool deck, the perfect spot for grilling, entertaining, and making lasting memories. Whether you’re spending your days at the beach or relaxing by the pool, this home offers everything you need for an unforgettable vacation. Book your stay today and experience the best of Blue Mountain Beach! Home Highlights: 4 Bedrooms, Private Pool, Gulf Views, bikes and golf cart. -Distance to Beach Access: 0.1 Miles (2 Minute Walk) -*Private Heated Pool and Spa. -Parking Spaces: (2) in Driveway -Dining Accommodations 14 *Pool Heat is available for an additional $330 (pre-tax). *The pool heater does require 24 hours to reach the optimal temperature of 83-85 degrees. Spa heated to same temperature. *Please contact Reservations to add this feature prior to your stay. Home Configuration + Sleeping Arrangements: Sleeps: 14 4 Bedrooms / 4 Full Baths / 1 Half Bath First Floor: Kitchen, Living Room with built in bar and icemaker, Dining Room, Laundry Room, Half Bath, Outdoor Living Area, Pool, and Outside Shower. Second Floor: -Bedroom 1: Master King Bed, ensuite bathroom with separate tub and shower -Bedroom 2: Queen Bed, ensuite bathroom with tub/shower combo -Furnished balcony with Gulf views Third Floor: -Bedroom 3: Bunk Room with (1) queen over queen bunk, (2) twin over twin bunks, ensuite bathroom with shower/tub combo -Bedroom 4: King Bed, Ensuite bathroom with separate tub and shower -Furnished balcony with amazing Gulf views Amenities Include: -4 Adult Bikes -Beach Towel Service -Golf Cart Please Note: *Beach access locations and beach vending companies are subject to change, per local county ordinances. For the most up-to-date information, please contact our office prior to your arrival. *The master bedroom fireplace and home surround sound are not functional. Lined with artsy villages, coastal lakes, upscale boutiques, eclectic beach bars, and world-class restaurants, Florida's Scenic Highway 30A has something for everyone. This unique destination has 25,000 acres of protected habitats. Among many things, this area is known for its family-friendly environment and is home to the world's most beautiful white sand beaches. The Timpoochee Trail bike path connects all the villages of 30A. Be sure to take your bike out and explore! The villages of 30A include: Dune Allen Beach, Blue Mountain Beach, Grayton Beach, WaterColor, Seaside, Seagrove Beach, WaterSound, Alys Beach, Seacrest Beach, Rosemary Beach, and Inlet Beach.
